title: videos
description: Video generation workflows and their limits (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C8b). The stable names are in model_aliases; `aliases` keeps the older exact names.

default_workflow.description: Workflow a video request runs when it names no model.

remix_workflow.description: Workflow of POST /v1/videos/{id}/remix and /v1/videos/edits. Unset: both answer 501.

extend_workflow.description: Chain workflow of POST /v1/videos/extensions. Unset: it answers 501.

chain_segment_seconds.description: Longest single segment of a chain, unless the workflow says otherwise.

allow_untracked_ids.description: Serve video ids made before job records were kept.

aliases.description: Older exact names of a workflow, lower-case, each naming a workflow id. The stable names are in model_aliases and win on a clash.

additionalProperties.description: One video workflow: the graph file and the limits it was built for. Replaced whole by an owner edit.

file.description: Graph file, relative to the install or absolute.

builder.description: Names a chain builder: the workflow joins segments of a longer video.

i2v_workflow.description: Workflow that runs when the request has an input image.

chain_workflow.description: Workflow that serves requests longer than this one runs.

node_roles.description: The nodes of the graph file that a request fills: prompt_node, size_node, length_nodes, seed_nodes, image_node and the like, each a node id or a list of ids. A role that names no node of the file is refused when the file loads.
